title: Dispatch over a sealed hierarchy

blocks.text: A switch of type patterns over a sealed interface can name every permitted type and need no `default`: the compiler checks the cases are exhaustive, and refuses the switch if a new vehicle type is added and not handled.

`TollGate` holds `sealed interface Vehicle permits Car, Truck, Motorcycle` and three records: `Car(int doors)`, `Truck(double cargoCapacity)` and `Motorcycle(boolean hasSidecar)`. Write `toll(Vehicle vehicle)` in `TollGate` as one switch expression with no `default`:

rows: `10`, plus `2` for each started tonne of capacity: `Truck(3.5)` pays `18`

cases.says: A car pays 5, a 3-tonne truck 16, and a motorcycle 2.
A 3.5-tonne truck pays 18: each started tonne counts.
A motorcycle with a sidecar pays 3.

concepts: A switch of type patterns over a sealed interface covers every permitted type with no default, and the compiler checks it.
